# Théâtre du Vaudeville

## Overview
The Théâtre du Vaudeville, boulevard des Capucines, Paris. Marie sees *Montjoye* there with the Gavini (083.0306), a society play in April 1879 (084.0716) and Daudet's *Le Nabab* in February 1880 (087.0411); 078.0435.
